name: product-charter
principles: Every change has a spec before it is implemented, and every spec lives in the spec catalog of its team.
Nets create context; only a coding agent behind a command transition writes code, and only from the context pack it is given.
The person merges. Branches only; nothing is pushed by a net.
Scripts measure, one-shot lanes judge, the brain keeps what was learned.
notes: goal ships as REPLACE ME: the product manager asks for it first. services lists the teams to install (node, master, ...); a team registers itself in p-product-teams when provisioned.
